rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a heap or mass of things gathered together.

example.english: There’s a pile of books on the desk.
example.jyutping: zoeng1 toi2 soeng6 min6 jau5 jat1 deoi1 syu1

rows.note: Use this for a pile made by placing relatively flat items or layers on top of one another.

example.english: I put a pile of documents on the desk.
example.traditional: 我將一疊文件放咗喺枱面。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zoeng1 jat1 dip6 man4 gin6 fong3 zo2 hai2 toi2 min6
